title: GTA5RP Util
description:
A desktop application for automatically checking criminal records in GTA5RP.

The app has a Qt interface (dark theme, sidebar navigation) that opens the in-game panel itself, enters passport numbers, recognizes the results table via OCR, and sorts them by category (AK / UK / both). Template matching is implemented without OpenCV — using numpy (FFT + integral image), which saved ~85 MB in the exe size. An overlay with progress and an ETA is shown on top of the game during the run.
